title: Indian Airforce Agniveer Vayu Intake 01/2027 Result: Out for Agniveer Recruitment #AgniveerVayu2027 #IndianAirforceAgniveer #SarkariNaukri
intro: Join Indian Airforce has Officially Released Result for the Post of Airforce Agniveers Vayu Intake 01/2027 Recruitment 2026. Exam Held on March 30-31, 2026 & Result Available On June 16, 2026. All Interested Candidates Can Download Result Now in The Given Link Below.

Minimum Height : 152.5 cms (Male)  ||  152 cms (Female)   ||  Minimum Height Form North East/ Hilly Areas: 147 cms  ||  Minimum Height Form Lakshadweep : 150 cms
Running: 1.6 km in 07 Minutes (Male)  ||  1.6 km in 08 Minutes (Female)
Exit After 4 Year as Agniveer in Indian Airforce - Rs 10.04 Lakh as Seva Nidhi Package.

AGNIVEER Skill Certificate:- At the end of engagement period, a detailed Skill-Set certificate will be provided to the AGNIVEER VAYU,highlighting the skills and level of competency acquired by the personnel during their engagement period.

Insurance:- Death and Disability Compensation. AGNIVEER VAYU will be provided non-contributory life Insurance cover of Rs 48 lakhs for the duration of their engagement period as AGNIVEER VAYU in the Indian Air Force. AGNIVEER VAYU will not be governed by provisions contained in the Pension Regulations/Rules for Indian Air Force. For details of Death/Disability compensation log on to https://agnipathvayu.cdac.in
Training: On being enrolled, AGNIVEER VAYU will be imparted military training based on Indian Air Force requirement.
Leave : Annual : 30 Days, Sick Leave. Based on Medical Advice.
The candidates who become Agniveer will get 10% reservation in recruitment in Assam Rifles, CAPF.
Uttar Pradesh / Madhya Pradesh and other states will also give preference to Agniveer in police department recruitment.
Personnel enrolled under this Scheme will not be eligible for Ex-Servicemen status.
Mode of Selection:- Selection on the Basis of Phase-I, Phase-II & Phase-III
8 February 2026: Last date for registration and fee payment.
24-48 hours before exam: Admit card release.
Science Subjects: 12th with PCM 50% marks + 50% in English OR 3-year Diploma in Engineering 50% marks OR 2-year Vocational with PCM.
Other Subjects: 12th 50% aggregate + 50% in English OR 2-year Vocational 50% aggregate.
Minimum Height: Male 152.5 cm | Female 152 cm (relaxation for hilly areas)
Minimum Chest: 77 cm with 5 cm expansion (Male)
Running: Male 1.6 km in 7 min | Female 1.6 km in 8 min
Insurance: Rs 48 lakh non-contributory life cover
Skill Certificate: Detailed skill-set certificate at end
Reservation: 10% in CAPF, Assam Rifles & state police
Indian Airforce Career: 4 years service + future opportunities
